description: Two-lane recommendations: guided (always) + semi-automated Green brokers (queued for Sprint 7). Urgency + ROI from PDSS marginal impact + dependency DAG.

lanes.guided: User-in-loop steps, freeze, DSAR/know templates, password hygiene, MFA
lanes.semi_automated: Green broker opt-outs via Playwright (Sprint 7 execution); planned in Sprint 6

templates.title: Change passwords on breached accounts
templates.summary: One or more breaches expose passwords or high-risk credentials. Change passwords and enable unique secrets.
steps: Identify accounts tied to the breached email
Change password to a unique high-entropy secret
Revoke sessions / app passwords if offered

templates.title: Enable multi-factor authentication
templates.summary: Reduce account takeover risk after credential exposure.
steps: Prefer TOTP or hardware key over SMS

templates.title: Place free credit / security freezes
templates.summary: High-impact identity exposure warrants freezes at major bureaus and specialty agencies (AIDR freeze lineage).

templates.title: Send right-to-know / access requests
templates.summary: Generate CCPA/GDPR access templates for brokers or processors holding your data (AIDR know lineage).
steps: Pick regime (CCPA default / GDPR if EU)
Record submission date for complaint deadlines

templates.title: Review and clean SERP footprint
templates.summary: Public search hits may amplify discoverability. Review URLs and request outdated content removal where appropriate.
steps: Request removal of outdated personal content where policy allows
Update privacy settings on linked profiles

templates.title: Opt out of Green data brokers
templates.summary: Queue AIDR-style Green broker opt-outs. Execution in Sprint 7 (Playwright + free CAPTCHA path).
steps: Confirm consent for automated form submission

templates.title: Rescan to verify improvement
templates.summary: After remediating high-impact findings, run a quota-aware rescan and recompute PDSS (closed loop).

freeze_recommend_rule.note: Maps AIDR recommendFreeze: any high-severity breach with sensitive data classes
